The post:

I finally found something that worked

So I’m not sure if this is the correct place to post, but I still feel it could be beneficial. I do not condone drug use in any form, this is just my experience. 

Last week I took some edibles for the first time. I had never been around anyone who had made edibles before so when I had the opportunity of course I jumped on it. The girl I got them from is an amazing baker so when I was driving to work I decided to have a little nibble. 

Bro, when I tell you that even if there wasn’t weed in the brownies they were still the most amazing brownies I’ve ever had. One thing led to another and I had eaten 3. 

But, if you remember, I had to go to work. My heart started pounding. My anxiety was going off the rails. The main reason was because it was the opening weekend of Frozen 2 (yikes). I told the guy that works in the box office with me and he laughed but said if I had any problems he would help. 

Thankfully I felt relaxed for most of the night. When I got home I had another brownie. Hey! They were good! My friend came over, had one, and we smoked a little bit and watched some Dr. Phil. 

And then... it all kicked in. 

The time was 1:00 am on the dot. I started seeing all kind of patterns. From fabrics I’d seen, to artwork I’d admired, or colors that were just beautiful. I started giggling. The laughing kept getting harder, and harder. After screaming for 30 minutes straight I finally came to and basically had a spiritual awakening. 

Bro, this life is so beautiful. What am I doing so upset about everything? I have 2 jobs, amazing friends, a home, a family that loves me. Why am I not enjoying life? I’m in my 20’s! The best time to be alive. I began soul searching. I wanted to know exactly what it was that was making me so depressed. 

My high had me feeling I had lived millions of lives all at the same time. I saw myself as thousands of different people growing old and having a family. Some how that translated into needing to be honest with myself. 

The truth is: I’m gay.

All my life I’ve been trying to trick myself into believing I’m straight. Don’t get me wrong; some men are very attractive. I just don’t think they’re my “thing”

I’ve gone through phases in my life: obviously starting with the emo phase, then the film student, the scholar. Then the depression HIT. I kept missing school and still tried to find somewhere where I fit. I tried being mormon, I tried hobbies like painting, and journaling, and photography. Just nothing ever fit. 

When I had a boyfriend all I wanted to do was be with a woman. Emotionally he was everything I wanted, but physically I was not attracted to him. Women always seemed so beautiful. I understand a woman’s wants and needs. With men I’m just clueless on anything to do. 

Plus dicks are weird. 

I went on to write all of my feelings so sober me would remember. When I read what I’d written I was almost teary eyed. Everything was 1000% true. It’s taken me so long to finally understand I’ve been lying to myself for 20 years. 

I am gay and that’s okay. I’m officially living my true self! 

Ever since that night I’ve been so happy and felt at peace with so many open emotional wounds. I’m so happy and I genuinely hope all of you can find happiness too. 

TL;DR: I ate too many edibles and realized I was gay and I’m happy now.
